decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a strategic option, distant from the core but cheap to maintain, and it supports one-stop service and deeper customer collaboration; its value is still uncertain, so keeping it open is rational.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, which is strong early evidence of value and justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep in the portfolio, and with its uncertainty not yet resolved after one year, the option stays open.
The small counter display is a low-cost standard format adjacent to existing capabilities, so keeping it preserves upside while results are still unknown.

The large freestanding information display fits the firm's broader 3D cardboard direction and is cheap to maintain, but it lacks reported results, so management keeps it while watching for evidence like the earlier dropped tray.
